label: API route default-imports zod, making `z` undefined and crashing on module load
withdrawn_reason: Test manufactures the failure: vi.mock('zod') sets default: undefined, while the installed zod 3.22.2 exports a default (lib/index.js:29 'exports.default = z'; index.mjs:4006 'export { z as default }'); the recorded head crash cannot occur against the real dependency. No runtime defect in the PR is demonstrated. Validated 2026-09-18.
note: the container test/fix/logs were copied into this defect's own directory so that every defect is an independent unit; container dirs remain only as provenance
